calibration.policy: One uniform world reduction for all retained clips, fixed .15 source-pixel scale for generated eating/reading atlas. No per-frame fitting. Shared feet anchors and authored nose contact. Existing walk/sleep/rest clips retained, no new video.
calibration.transition_note: Retain crossfade with80ms duration because incompatible old rise/lie_down clips change body proportions. New eating/reading are two generated image poses; full skeletal motion is a later phase.
calibration.eating_note: Single stable authored feeding pose: second generated frame has incompatible face and foot positions and is excluded. Nose at source(236,527), foot anchor(320,550), fixed source scale0.15.
